-- Add salon fields to products table
ALTER TABLE products 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS productionDestination ENUM('KITCHEN','BAR','BOTH','NONE') DEFAULT 'NONE',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS availableInSalon BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

-- Salon configuration per company
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS salonConfig (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  companyId INT NOT NULL,
  defaultTipPercent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 10.00,
  tipEnabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  gratuityLabel VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Gorjeta (10%)',
  kitchenLabel VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Cozinha',
  barLabel VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Bar',
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY salon_config_company_idx (companyId)
);

-- Salon tables (mesas)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS salonTables (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  companyId INT NOT NULL,
  number INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100),
  capacity INT DEFAULT 4,
  status ENUM('FREE','OCCUPIED','WAITING_PAYMENT','RESERVED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FREE',
  positionX INT DEFAULT 0,
  positionY INT DEFAULT 0,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX salon_table_company_idx (companyId),
  UNIQUE KEY salon_table_number_idx (companyId, number)
);

-- Salon orders (comandas)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS salonOrders (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  companyId INT NOT NULL,
  tableId INT NOT NULL,
  tableNumber INT NOT NULL,
  waiterId VARCHAR(64),
  waiterName VARCHAR(200),
  guestCount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  status ENUM('OPEN','WAITING_PAYMENT','CLOSED','CANCELLED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
  subtotal DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  tipPercent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  tipAmount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  totalAmount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  notes TEXT,
  openedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  closedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  saleId INT NULL,
  INDEX salon_order_company_idx (companyId),
  INDEX salon_order_table_idx (tableId),
  INDEX salon_order_status_idx (status),
  INDEX salon_order_opened_idx (openedAt)
);

-- Salon order items (itens da comanda)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS salonOrderItems (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  orderId INT NOT NULL,
  companyId INT NOT NULL,
  productId INT NOT NULL,
  productName VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  quantity DECIMAL(10,3) NOT NULL,
  unitPrice DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  totalPrice DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  productionDestination ENUM('KITCHEN','BAR','BOTH','NONE') DEFAULT 'NONE',
  status ENUM('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS','READY','DELIVERED','CANCELLED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  sentAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  readyAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  deliveredAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX salon_item_order_idx (orderId),
  INDEX salon_item_company_idx (companyId),
  INDEX salon_item_status_idx (status),
  INDEX salon_item_dest_idx (productionDestination)
);

-- Salon order payments (pagamentos da comanda)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS salonOrderPayments (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  orderId INT NOT NULL,
  companyId INT NOT NULL,
  method ENUM('CASH','CREDIT','DEBIT','PIX','VOUCHER') NOT NULL,
  amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX salon_payment_order_idx (orderId),
  INDEX salon_payment_company_idx (companyId)
);
